originalTitle: Battlefield 6 x Top Gun: Carrier Strike Cinematic Trailer
content: Play Top Gun in Season 4 for free starting August 18. Take to the skies and become the best of the best. The Top Gun update arrives in Battlefield 6 on August 18, bringing high-speed aerial combat, legendary battlefields, and new ways to dominate the Pacific. Pilot the new F/A-81F Super Spectre and F-74A Seacat two-seat fighter jets with your wingman, master intense dogfights in Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep, and fight across land, sea, and air in the reimagined Carrier Strike. Return to the iconic Wake Island, rebuilt for Battlefield 6 with large-scale combined-arms combat across its beaches, bunkers, and surrounding waters. Complete event challenges to earn Top Gun-themed rewards and unlock the Interdictor, Battlefield 6's longest-range sniper rifle, through the Battle Pass. The update also expands Tsuru Reef with playable aircraft carriers, bringing the reimagined Carrier Strike experience to Battlefield's biggest map yet. #battlefield6 #topgun
chineseContent: 从 8 月 18 日开始，免费畅玩《壮志凌云》第 4 季。飞向天空，成为强者中的强者。 《战地 6》的《壮志凌云》更新将于 8 月 18 日发布，带来高速空战、传奇战场以及称霸太平洋的新方式。与僚机一起驾驶新型 F/A-81F Super Spectre 和 F-74A Seacat 两座战斗机，在《Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep》中掌控激烈的空战，并在重新构想的《航母打击》中横扫陆地、海上和空中。回到标志性的威克岛，这里是为《战地 6》而重建的，在海滩、掩体和周围水域进行大规模的多兵种战斗。完成活动挑战即可获得 Top Gun 主题奖励，并通过 Battle Pass 解锁《战地 6》射程最远的狙击步枪 Interdictor。此次更新还通过可玩的航空母舰扩展了鹤礁，将重新构想的航母打击体验带入战地迄今为止最大的地图。 #战地6 #topgun
